modules.title: Causal learning, conversion and composition settlement
modules.purpose: Turns bounded counterfactual research evidence into explicit causal classifications, immutable receipts and next-work decisions without confusing research signals with authority.
invariants: Explicit unused-draft mixed-price discovery preserves twenty original model/episode and ten pair identities but settles them only in its own neutral namespace. Genuine technical originals and unexecuted exact-control dependents are not measured zero effects; no ordinary mutation advice, pair effect, credit or economic handoff is emitted (ADR-035).

Finite DSL search seals a verified registered semantic pool, explicit typed as-of task, original macro sources, equal resource caps and blinded seed before execution. Two complete original native products measure only that finite task; changed labels/seeds cannot renew its physical question. No general synthesis, independent market or economic authority follows (ADR-032).

Pure behavior-archive consumption re-verifies original entries and screening projection policy before a bounded research-priority contribution. The selected block seals source entry/run/request/response references; withheld technical-completion runs cannot escape through an archive and consumption does not assert confirmed value or a qualified specialist (ADR-032).

The signed observed-completion projection withholding closes only its exact constructor mutation-selection episodes with append-only zero-authority settlements after all six immutable runs and original feedback are terminal. It never re-runs consolidation, rewrites decisions/assessment/feedback, grants credit or replenishes the root cap (ADR-031).

One explicitly authorized observed probe-attestation completion requires an original terminal drained six-seat cohort, three immutable native owner-collision errors, unchanged current vectors/data/cost/risk and verified old/new source artifacts. Its server-derived signed lineage root is locked and globally capped at one completion, including failed successors; no cached outcome import, independent sample, renewed scientific budget or credit follows (ADR-030).

One original drained clean-discovery cohort with exact immutable pre-execution MTF validator refusal may receive one unchanged-question replacement under fresh full/Python source. Every attempted and unexecuted dependent arm is re-attested; original plus one is the maximum, with no constructor/preparation chain, new vectors, scientific budget reset or authority (ADR-025).

Causal discovery and Research Mentor do not depend on paper profitability. Paper admission consumes original-source and exact-trait causal verification; the reverse E4 performance/Economic Parent receipt is later feedback documented in shared integrations, not a prerequisite for causal execution.

Creation seals the primary Academy frozen-control owner and explicit admission-only candidate control IDs after hypothesis cleanup. Kernel pair contracts retain actual control and candidate IDs; no same-family fallback can silently substitute another control.

Academy primary arms share one compiler-verified trial-owned instrument surface before any ordinary pair lookup or cache reuse. Exact baseline, roster, context, source and parameter delta are prerequisites; this multi-arm reservation is not an ordinary economic pair or instrument-credit proof.

Laravel and Python refuse a blocked or unready required instrument reservation before replay, even when its assignment and aggregate contract are rehashed; a missing optional inventory is not silently reclassified as a required reservation.

Fresh Academy and kernel constructors seal current-family parameter fingerprints with the shared schema canonicalizer and current local-adapter genome; missing or stale historical metadata is never copied as the new model identity. Draft verification remains strict after JSON roundtrip and real value changes.

One original cold cohort may receive one attested missing-identity constructor replacement and one distinct contained preparation repair, never more than three total cohorts. The preparation repair requires original bounded-timeout operational envelopes, request-bound snapshot_loaded checkpoint, zero scientific output and a drained approved disposition; all twenty preregistered parameter vectors, question, data/MTF/cost and stable budget remain exact under fresh IDs/source.

The confirmation runtime specification is explicit-owner Academy research, not generic library rotation. A fresh strategy/tactic/management passport preserves sealed parameters and risks exactly; parameter-preserving management has no override and cannot inherit an incompatible historical passport.

Academy plans only executable adapter values. A new trial may create one locked draft plus durable canonical-admission intent; the arbiter alone selects preparation and dispatch through trading:dispatch-lab. Historical passports are not prospectively re-sealed.

Ready proof-carrying Academy curriculum and director continuation precede fresh discovery. The one-cohort stable-input cold-start allowance also precedes new discovery, but never active closure, recovery or earned proof; depth or a planned-trial label alone is not continuation evidence.

Stage mastery compares ordered candle/event identities and actual data/execution/evaluator bindings, not equal counts. Setup topology explicitly owns context/location/setup together; no exclusive single-stage claim is inferred.

Exact-delta authorized validation epochs have independent statistics. Legacy/discovery evidence remains observable but cannot poison or certify a validation epoch; every authority fact rechecks its original pair, run and window provenance.
Instrument selection may recommend only its proven gene old/new delta in the exact tested context and compatible baseline, never every gene listed on a capability card.

External idea identity includes context, bounded genes, component species, block design and stopping rule. Only matching ready execution designs may claim the idea; unsupported designs remain deferred, never relabelled novelty.

Code-owned capability cards distinguish parameter adapters, structural proxies and unavailable descriptions; catalog names and management profiles are not unique algorithms. Cards and activation events share one owner and are sealed in the assignment.

Generic mutation genes resolve to the actual strategy-family instrument adapter. A four-seat activation proposal requires both axes to have observed source opportunity, reachable stage, bound data and a prospectively freezable exact control; an unknown observation count is not fabricated uncertainty or credit.

The arbiter reconciles only open exact-pair instrument projections; an attested frozen-control invocation closes as control_reference_consumed without causal credit. Terminal historical receipts are not reopened, and historical reference maintenance cannot starve fresh research.

Controlled factorial attribution requires four unique eligible arm receipts sharing dataset, MTF, execution, context and session identities; effects are recomputed from their values, and activation-only blocks cannot create economic attribution.

Directional harmful authority requires exact old/new gene values and context plus three authorized non-overlapping negative windows and original verified settlements; legacy repeated losses cannot block the whole gene.
A preregistered equal-cap three-arm benchmark settles only from complete hash-valid folds as executed_diagnostic and grants neither measured-compute equivalence nor compounding/credit authority.

Instrument posterior authority requires a validation replay manifest with post-paper source and candle bounds plus server-authorized dataset receipts from non-overlapping, distinct-hash windows; at least two separate positive windows, complete evidence-key coverage, and exact context are mandatory. Ordinary pre-2026 screening, arbitrary window labels and 2026 paper candles never count.

Successor instrument consumption is recorded only when an actual parameter difference matches a confirmed component and bundle with the same full state key and requested context; retrieval or preference alone is not application or paper authority.
Venue-phase instrument attribution uses the same exact five-axis activation and candidate/control trade context; legacy session-only or mixed-granularity slices cannot create a phase-local posterior.
A confirmed venue-phase posterior can affect next-generation mutation only in an explicitly matching requested phase, never from a broader session-only context.
Work lifecycle, evidence validity, causal claim and authority are distinct dimensions.
Counterfactual arms retain frozen control, data and execution identity.

Prospective repair seals the exact declared parent semantic group separately from canonical decision context; both candidate and control must belong to it. Blinded mutation uses the same baseline Edge Genesis feasibility firewall, never memory ranking.
Prospective repair runs as one exact three-arm cohort; unrelated discovery seats cannot invalidate its comparison.

The initial attempt may receive two distinct unobserved constructor repairs. One final versioned transport repair is allowed only when that third attempt's exact control has a single 780s bounded-timeout error run with no strategy/trade receipt and its two peers were blocked by that control. Four attempts exhaust the source; any scientific result forbids reuse.
Discovery's 15000 evaluated rows and 512 warmup rows are separately sealed and attested; the three arms share one window hash, and paper-epoch rows are forbidden.
A causal confirmation passport resolves to the frozen control's exact executable family and any declared architecture and tactic before construction.
Terminal scientific uncertainty is classified explicitly rather than fabricated as success or causal rejection.
A receipt and next durable action are recorded atomically or not at all.
Autonomous causal confirmation executes one three-arm fold per retryable job; only a complete 9-of-9 receipt set may cross the aggregate settlement boundary.
A terminal triplet without three completed immutable screening receipts is invalidated before fold dispatch and grants no causal credit.
Composition credit requires explicit independently attested component evidence.

Post-v2 repair and causal-skill credits are issued atomically and idempotently only after the confirmed three-arm experiment, component escrow, exact pair and settlement agree; they grant no paper or parent authority.
An instrument assignment may be reused or credited only when its source strategy, tactic, risk and management still match the frozen composition passport.

A four-arm activation result is a behavioral hypothesis, never component/economic credit. Immutable trace, paired opportunity universe and MTF identity must agree before a conversion receipt. A future post-paper research interval is preregistered with the intervention, but remains non-executable until a distinct authorized research dataset exists; the 2026 paper epoch is never silently reused.

Caller flags/shortlists and old chosen/matched SOLO grant nothing; original physical input/warmup/context/holding exposure and immutable selected-source proof own every stage (ADR-033).

Persisted operator approval registers a new bounded attributed-price question only; the current arbiter decision alone prepares and dispatches it. Actual compressed request/response/trace bytes own measured receipts; 15000 selected rows plus 512 feature warmup retain the ordinary 200 execution warmup and 14800 unique decision candles. Event counts are not candle coverage. Genuine technical originals and unexecuted exact-control refusals receive separate neutral dispositions; twenty own episodes and ten own pair dispositions close only after owned queue drain, with zero ordinary credit or gate fanout.

The server preserves and hashes the exact source member and derives only capital_weight 1.0; observed sources, old plans, follow-up reuse and caller best-qualified claims are refused. Actual native account/trace/clock parity still owns comparison.

Controlled native spread-study traces retain canonical audit projection, but their typed generation/carrier/run/request/response declarations exclude ordinary historical mutation advice and causal priors. Old mixed aggregate cache identities and tainted append-only insights are not consumed; dedicated original paired measurement is the result owner.

Prospective matched-member SOLO is an explicit specialist_council_native_solo_v1 declaration. The owner derives one unchanged native member from the original stored council, preserves its allocation, passport, cost and risk, and attests the same actual account clock and metrics. A legacy plan or later follow-up signature cannot add that declaration; matched allocation is not best full-budget standalone proof (ADR-032).

A prospective native spread-context study owns two unused same-draft carriers with one unchanged native program, common physical data/clock/cost/risk and a pre-outcome question seal. It masks only the instrument decision-context spread_liquidity_state, records contemporaneous Entry/WAIT decisions and excluded coverage, and grants no profit, causal credit or paper authority. Existing constructor and dispatcher remain the only admission path (ADR-032).

A signed observed-completion cohort with six completed original runs and immutable technical feedback closes its exact mutation-selection episodes with zero-authority settlements before the terminal watermark. A technical council disposition remains technical at generation close without rewriting agent verdicts; blocked settle-only closure is deferred, not reported as progress (ADR-031).

An explicit native_specialist_council_intent_v1 may open exactly six new schema-root references through the same XAUUSD/H1 historical constructor, shared admission and locks. Its comparison purpose retains four sources plus candidate/ablation; a separately declared spread_context_study purpose retains four sources plus masked/unmasked carriers. The new purpose and exact supported spread/context declaration are original-intent-owned and cannot be injected into an old comparison or follow-up. Sources/carriers are not qualified specialists. Intent is unforced and excludes ordinary causal/pair/cooperative ownership or inherited vectors; creator/question/hash bind all six markers. Original atomic preparation remains mandatory for dispatcher/snapshot admission, including deleted context with retained markers/origin. Ordinary population paths are unchanged.

Technical recovery targets the shared lookback gate's actual generation and actionable agent IDs, not an already-reconciled latest generation. A named drained cohort with a canonical original source/data/execution seal and genuinely changed evaluator may append at most two terminal-only withheld dispositions per cycle; it never replays mixed source, alters old scientific receipts or consumes replay dispatch budget. Missing, malformed or current source proofs stay explicit blocked dependencies, and target progress changes the arbiter watermark.

Specialist scalp/hour/day/swing horizons are distinct from sensor timeframes. Stored passports, native model vectors and common account execution policies own a declared council replay; an invalid explicit binding never silently falls back to legacy strategy execution.

Council comparison plans preregister equal capital, costs, risk, original windows and champion/solo/ablation/retention identities before evidence. The creator cannot self-certify; research comparison never grants independent, paper or live authority.

Prospective council preparation locks the canonical dispatch lease and a complete unused draft; every native member and arm must belong to that draft, without another experiment owner or prior queue/replay seals. Each research window requires its candidate, exact solo and at least one ablation before dispatch. Preparation creates no generation or evaluator job.

Optional council clean discovery freezes the original bundle/manifest hashes only after the existing MTF readiness and actual stream restoration verify the exact 15000 evaluated plus 512 warmup rows and original plan calendar. Shared dispatcher/admission/evaluator guards accept that verified owner or the unchanged Academy owner, never a label. All prepared generation models and current source hashes remain research-only; a declared broken preparation throws and cannot fall through to full replay or promotion.

A council research comparison can close without an earned champion or retention proof, but remains research-only at screening and full-replay selection. Missing original data, insufficient matured power and technical parity failures remain distinct from local negative or null outcomes; independent qualification still requires its complete original authorized-window comparisons.

Original council assessment atomically publishes a scoped conversion receipt and knowledge through the existing conversion kernel. A local negative/null closes only its preregistered hypothesis; a promising observation or missing prerequisite leaves a blocked non-executable dependency, never a skill credit or global harmful ban.

New council preparation consumes at most eight server-verified prior feedback receipts and seals their exact IDs, hashes, source runs and digest in the plan. Retry revalidates the original snapshot, not a new ranking. A bounded original-receipt lookup refuses an already-completed same-release physical question even under new labels; a changed release does not make repeated market events independent.
Version adoption and rollback affect future entries only. Open positions retain their original owner and management version; the existing arbiter remains the only autonomous research selector.

Before fresh construction or queue admission, an attested native continuity failure fences the identical actual M5 source SHA. A prospective repair must pass the existing data owner's receipt, row and file guards; Academy waits for that selected dataset's own canonical quoted MTF bundle and never relabels an old bundle.

A contained Academy preparation repair reuses the original bounded kernel gene old/new vectors on the same frozen baseline/data/cost, under fresh IDs and current schema/genome seals. It cannot resample sixteen different discoveries, touch protected primary axes, copy old receipts or replenish the question budget.

Explicit historical research and admitted causal confirmation validate the pre-2026 foundation instead of requiring fresh live candles. Their archive identity is sealed before construction, rechecked against the frozen foundation and M5/H4/H1/M15 periods before dispatch, and cannot bypass active work, technical recovery, protocol pause, exact controls, risk or paper gates.

Activation discovery ranks sealed instrument data/context opportunities and stage reachability before capped signal volume, never using current/live state or validation profit. Missing power/data remains a dependency, not a negative skill or a reason to relax risk gates.

Prospective repair binds its sealed source context to all three replay arms and requires a matching runtime scope receipt; context-eligible candles and accepted strategy signals are distinct measures.
A prospective release is sealed after snapshot/MTF creation and before queue admission; source, worker, data or cost drift cannot become a scientific replay result.

Stagnation requiring N adjacent comparisons loads at least N+1 scientific generations and never bridges a missing score. Velocity numerators and denominators use the same lookback; repeated failures are not the rejection fraction.
Missing observed liquidity defers mutation-only activation proposals; the diagnostic reports upstream signal and exact veto counts without rewriting canonical evidence.
Construction and control identities remain attributable.
A frozen composition passport owns the final constructor family, architecture and tactic.
A cached instrument assignment is reusable only while every source component still equals the frozen passport; the composition ID alone is insufficient.
A model persists separate instrument-policy retrieval and actual policy-aligned parameter-consumption receipts; merely selecting a posterior never asserts that a gene was inherited.
Causal source control and composition passport identities agree before arm construction; stale dependencies degrade only to non-credit diagnostic controls.
Ordinary XAUUSD cohorts retain H1 as storage identity but use a frozen M5/H4/H1/M15 replay bundle.
Autonomous lifecycle screening delegates to the canonical lab dispatcher; no direct evaluator queue path may bypass immutable snapshot and MTF admission.
Missing gate evidence cannot pass a lifecycle boundary.
Failed evidence is retained for diagnosis but is not promotion evidence.

Append-only failed queue rows block admission only while their agents belong to the current recovery lookback or active lineage head; older quarantines remain historical evidence and cannot starve every successor.
A clean generation becomes an autonomy proof only after an arbiter-owned successor is linked by an immutable receipt; acceptance requires two consecutive linked receipts.
A single-agent screening recovery rechecks the exact frozen-control admission before evaluator execution; an incomplete control can never yield an unpaired candidate screen result.
A data-edge audit authorizes at most its own immediate successor; inherited audit context is provenance, not repeatable generation admission.

A research-only activation factorial consumes four seats only when a terminal immutable source has a bounded strategy-to-tactic gap and two legal distinct interventions; its control is the source executable vector and prequeue admission attests C/A/B/A+B exact deltas.
An unavailable activation factorial records its first missing proof and eligibility funnel while preserving the ordinary twenty-seat allocation and credit ceiling.

An unphased historical signal is hypothesis-only. One prospective research-only phase probe may replace one cold-start repair pair; its phase, source bytes, source genome, passport, exact-control baseline and one diagnostic delta are sealed before queueing. Both arms receive screening receipts but cannot pass economic screening or earn credit. A complete phase-bound tactic-veto settlement may open a later source-owned C/A/B/A+B discovery block, not promotion.

Every ordinary 20-seat allocation receives the already-reserved generation number and seals one owner per seat. The immediate terminal predecessor's cooperative settlement IDs and content hashes form a feedback digest; at most one cold-start pair is reassigned by valid negative, underpowered or technical-invalid evidence, while three causal-proof seats and one uncertainty-abstain seat remain protected. Prequeue admission rejects source-receipt, owner or manifest drift. A positive research signal cannot unlock replication, factorial, descendant or credit authority.

modules.title: Laravel and Python execution contract
modules.purpose: Preserves the versioned, canonical request, response and hash boundary between Laravel authority/persistence and FastAPI deterministic computation.
invariants: unused_draft_price_discovery_preparation_v1 adds only a typed research header to unchanged source-release transport and Python parameters/gates. Actual compressed original request/response/trace bytes distinguish 15000 selected evaluated rows, 512 feature warmup, 200 ordinary execution warmup and 14800 unique decision candles; event counts are distinct and grant no economics or authority (ADR-035).

Chosen full-account native SOLO retains an exact hash-valid compiled source member; Python permits only its prospectively declared allocation delta to 1.0 before compute. PHP requires original account/cost/risk/program/horizon and actual trace/clock attestation. Chosen-unqualified is not best/eligible authority, and legacy or observed follow-ups cannot retrofit the declaration.

native_spread_context_study_v1 changes only the computed instrument spread context, never raw quotes, prices, execution fees or hard risk. Its in-loop receipt distinguishes shared eligible gate events, unreached gates and account-diverged coverage; complete immutable original arms must share physical clock/source/program/cost before research-only Entry/WAIT sensitivity can settle.

Optional native member liquidity_atr_binding is a fixed-vocabulary closed input port compiled from the original source membership cell, not a study-only fallback. Both the actual gate and observer consume that same explicit field and receipt its source/value hash; signed study identity must match the native member. Unknown, absent or invalid inputs do not manufacture liquidity, and legacy undeclared context behavior remains unchanged.

replay_executed_clock_v1 observes each actual loop's previous-closed signal and next-open execution indices/timestamps in constant space. Input-selection warmup/probe counts cannot attest executed clocks; ordinary/native/authorized producers are independently bound to their original request and account owner. Missing/stale/malformed clocks or unequal physical schedule/index digests make an original comparison unassessable before economic deltas, not a strategy loss. Legacy evaluator starts are not silently changed or historical receipts backfilled.

A per-candidate specialist_council_runtime_v1 executes on one chronological account with shared reservations, costs, exposure and owner-pinned positions. Adding separately computed specialist PnLs is not a native council replay.

Native specialist_council_receipt_v1 seals dataset, execution, member/version identities and actual account/position ledgers; original-request attestation precedes screen/full cache or learning consumption.

typed_operator_decision_v1 binds a registered bounded AST/CALL program to actual closed inputs for confirmation, risk reduction or exit. Caller vectors, future inputs, risk increases and unsupported temporal semantics cannot enter the decision path. Exact JSON copies must agree with transported content before hash checking.

Optional policy_context.research_program_task is a bounded pure typed whitelist task, not strategy or arbitrary code. CALL expansion/as-of inputs and producer output identity must match; unsupported temporal semantics remain a dependency. Interpreter CPU is not measured synthesis/search advantage.

API replay and direct closed-MTF feature preparation share the exact clean-discovery scope/probe boundary. Enabled confirmation admits the typed incremental bundle only after that guard; full foundation protocol and all four path/SHA checks remain strict.

Only an original completed server-authorized post-paper window can receive authorized_research_transport_v1 for full replay. The deterministic HMAC binds the persisted release and all actual CSV paths/hashes/UTC rows before cache reuse; literal 2026 stays forbidden. Transport admission is not independent evidence or credit.

File-sealed MTF replay forbids inline primary/context/related replacements before cache or execution; hashes attest the same parsed bytes and actual consumed rows, including after strategy feature computation and cache reuse.

Stage proof emits replay_decision_identity_v2 with semantic direction, geometry and entry-linked exit/outcome hashes; consumed_dependency_identity_v1 seals actual context-stream sources and as-of joins. Equal totals or candle membership do not prove unchanged behavior; old/missing receipts are unassessable, not scientific no-effect.

Gap clocks and causal volume buckets use the actual execution timeframe. Missing/NaN quote rows remain unknown, and malformed required or optional HTF streams cannot be silently cleaned into evidence.

Prospective research pins source, loaded worker, dataset and economic parameters before queue admission; Laravel and Python validate the aggregate release and request dataset/cost identity, Python API/cache and child execution attest the boot source, and Laravel requires the returned receipt. Attempted legacy generations are never backfilled.
Upstream strategy opportunities survive specialist veto in emitted receipts; missing measured liquidity is distinct from no signal and modeled execution spread never replaces an observation.
A prospective instrument research trace keeps exact venue-phase activation keys and trade-ledger slices together; Laravel cannot substitute broad session envelopes for phase-local posterior evidence.
Laravel and Python must agree on required protocol and sealed identity fields.

Instrument spread context uses the same canonical aliases in Laravel, Python matching and research attribution (liquid/low_spread to normal; illiquid to high). Raw observed labels and masked unknown remain traceable; alias equivalence never manufactures measured liquidity or changes execution prices/costs.
HTTP success alone is never evidence attestation.
A mismatched hash fails at the owning boundary.

Prospective screens verify exact warmup/evaluation rows, UTC bounds, month counts and data/execution identities before replay and before learning; a legacy short replay cannot satisfy the new evaluator receipt.

Each sealed 15k probe owns one bounded queue job and its own finite child deadline below the Laravel transport and queue lease; several typed candidates cannot share that deadline or run recursively under one lease. Generic short screens retain batching. A technical timeout cannot stand in for a replay receipt.
A declared composition must bind strategy, tactic, risk and management before replay starts.
One composition execution authority must also bind symbol, execution timeframe, dataset or MTF bundle, execution assumptions and the exact instrument assignment.
Instrument assignment source strategy, tactic, risk and management must equal the frozen passport, even if a stale assignment is internally hash-valid.
bound flags are not self-attesting; Python rechecks component identities, required typed nodes and aggregate hashes before replay.
consumed requires hash-valid in-loop receipts for every required node and one decision-ID witness spanning entry, MTF permission, risk, fill and managed trade close.
Typed pre-entry stage receipts are emitted where the signal is admitted or vetoed; final trace assembly may not reconstruct their predicates post hoc.
Legacy typed-program protocols cannot silently execute under a changed graph.
XAUUSD H1 is a laboratory storage identity; autonomous replay executes on M5 with one frozen H4/H1/M15 context bundle.
Historical volume context must come from the exact replay snapshot provenance, never from rolling/live coverage.

An optional synchronized quote sidecar is admitted before freezing a new M5 bundle and changes its content/release identity; unavailable quotes remain unknown and never borrow modeled execution spread.

modules.title: Runtime operations, scheduler and recovery
modules.purpose: Owns health observation, scheduler/queue recovery boundaries, operational readiness and safe runbook-guided remediation.
invariants: Price-discovery registration occurs only after explicit approval and named unused-draft/source/boot checks. Registration admits no work; current arbiter/control revision alone prepares and dispatches. Its PREPARE and DISPATCH commands permit at most two undelivered publication retries, never executed/semantic-deferred replay or question-cap renewal (ADR-035).

Spent price-discovery originals remain outside ordinary technical replay recovery, full/pair and successor fanout. Unrelated earned work retains priority; terminal commandless WAIT binds current canonical native physical byte/calendar dependency, so real later source repair changes the state without replaying or upgrading old price evidence.

Explicit unsealed-draft cold maintenance accepts only one named fully constructed unused draft under drain-first STOP, with absent constructor ownership, no source/admission/replay seals or attempted arms and all queues known-empty. Default rolling reload and sealed native owners remain strict. Read-only preflight, two authenticated idle probes and actual new worker boot seals are required; the original data dependency and draft are not rewritten (ADR-032).

Default rolling reload still requires no active generation. Explicit terminal-projection cold maintenance accepts only one named signed observed-completion cohort whose original arms/feedback are terminal, all queues are known-empty and control is drain-first STOP; it still requires fresh authenticated replay-idle probes. It grants neither replay nor another completion (ADR-031).

An exact admitted generation reservation can precede its immutable run and waits only within actual transport visibility plus the original serialized retry deadline. The canonical backend-neutral generation lab membership digest owns deduplication; unknown/expired/unrelated jobs and scheduler-child noise cannot renew progress, and genuine no-work settlement retains its bounded safety halt.

Targeted superseded-run recovery is explicit, backend-neutral and bounded to twenty original IDs. Disabled admission, idle authenticated replay/known-empty laboratory queues, terminal agent/generation, absent same-host PID and a later same-phase completed original response artifact are required. It closes only response-less open attempts as operational retry_released, preserving old source/data/parameter/start facts and every later verdict; it grants no replay, learning or promotion evidence.

The already-locked non-dry arbiter drains bounded native council evaluation deliveries after immutable run publication. Pause fences recovery; STOP may drain admitted deliveries. Retry never replays an arm, rewrites original evidence, self-qualifies a version or creates another scheduler.

A native immutable unexpected-candle-gap envelope closes evaluator retry debt as a data dependency, not a strategy result. The same actual M5 source bytes remain blocked before fresh discovery and queue admission despite source or bundle-label changes; only verified prospective provider data may select new input, without changing old receipts or resetting the original question cap.

Approved Academy preparation containment records its original request/checkpoint/source and zero-scientific-output disposition before canceling only generation-owned batches. Active replay is never killed; canceled deliveries consume normally, then untouched agents finalize after drain. Shared recovery readiness requires the immutable attestation, not a reason label.

Academy publication recovery is bounded to two undelivered transport retries. publication_failed fences stale deliveries; a running/completed/deferred/failed command is not silently retried as an undelivered scientific trial.
Provisional promotion debt and cartridge selection share one dispatch-readiness predicate; confidence alone cannot block exploration with unexecutable debt.

Until a valid non-invalidated XAUUSD champion exists, archive-first exploration skips live drift freshness after higher-priority settlement, recovery and ready research work. A missing or changed archive has its own dependency watermark; reused archive rows never become independent confirmation.
A policy pause is reported distinctly from an operational failure.
A PM2-owned project suppresses fallback queue consumers during PM2 worker recycle; the fallback starts only when PM2 has no project PHP owner.
Recovery cannot manufacture research, paper or promotion evidence.
Strict verification decides health after remediation.
An unchanged operational state hash cannot enqueue another arbiter child merely because the scheduler minute or the selected scheduler job's own queue residency changed.
An operator PAUSE fences new research admission and queued scheduler children without cancelling the current generation; RESUME changes the durable control revision and reselects that same lineage.
An unchanged active-generation settlement may receive two spaced retries after a completed child, then persists safety_halt instead of spinning or remaining silently frozen.
An active immutable evaluation run inside the bounded queue lease is progress in flight, not an unchanged settlement; a replay mutex release is not by itself queue retry-storm evidence.

A disk source hash and worker PID alone are not loaded-code proof; prospective queue/API boot hashes and returned replay receipts attest the worker release, while the read-only audit separately verifies the Git artifact. Legacy evidence stays unsealed.

An explicitly built content-addressed source archive attests allowlisted source bytes, not a clean Git commit, loaded workers or scientific progress. Only a new matching prospective seal may reference it; old seals are never backfilled.

Source maintenance uses existing STOP to drain admitted replay/settlement before worker recycling and START on the same lineage. PAUSE also fences settlement children. An online AI owner requires two authenticated zero-count replay probes; durable idle checks always apply. Probe failures refuse PM2 mutation without raw diagnostics. Missing authorized research data remains a separate dependency.

An in-flight research-loop decision suppresses a successor only while the matching scheduled command's unique queue lock is live; a stale database status without that lock is fenced and cannot own work.
Actionable technical recovery at the terminal lineage head precedes drift or fresh-data generation writers; an exit-zero blocked generation command is not a completed writer.

modules.title: Paper execution and process integrity
modules.purpose: Records paper signals, orders, fills and outcomes while enforcing risk and process gates without granting live-trading authority.
invariants: Locked native intake marks owned positions from fresh closed candles and pinned spread, slippage, commission and accrued carry. Missing marks or historical peak refuse new risk while management and retries continue. Spendable risk uses min(realized balance, marked equity); actual observed peak is monotonic and never backfilled from missing historical evidence (ADR-032).

The existing paper monitor is the sole council adoption clock. Opt-in running control may deliver at most eight due council identities per cycle to the native locked original-evidence owner; pause, stop, drain or safety halt fences adoption and new native entry but never the reconciliation of owned positions. Read-only minute paging prevents rejected versions from starving another due council.

Opt-in native specialists still require their own E3/E4 frozen admission. Shared account reservations lock integer capital before order publication, cannot double-spend across members, and may only narrow sentinel, discipline and external global risk limits.

Specialist orders pin council, owner, strategy, tactic, management and source request versions. Disabling new council entries or retiring a version cannot stop existing owned position management. Unsupported broker netting or fill accounting remains a dependency.

E3/E4 reuse, capture and fill re-read the persisted model and candidate against the original frozen identity; fill locks candidate/model/signal until order and entry-fill publication. Legacy admissions or signals without the new identity are blocked, never backfilled.
A changed or missing sealed contract cannot create a paper order.
NO_TRADE decisions are persisted evidence, not implicit errors.
Invalid process outcomes are quarantined from learning.
